title: SetupStatus
description: GET /setup: what the first-run screen (S0-1) needs. Files are downloaded at first run, never shipped (§2, §6).

id.description: llama: llama.cpp server build. model: base GGUF.

status.description: installed: usable. partial: a resumable download is on disk. missing: nothing yet.

path.description: Where the server looks (default under the data dir, or the path the user set).

custom.description: True when the user pointed to an existing file or folder.

remaining_bytes.description: Still to download for everything not installed.

free_bytes.description: Free space on the data dir's drive.

job_id.description: Download or path check running now, if any.
